selection.selection_timing: Figure selection rule recorded before inspecting selected response traces; deterministic identifiers, not outcome ranks.
selection.atlas: All 12 source objects + 24 ID + 24 OOD; both displayed commands and every seed; no outcome-based exclusion.

transformations: Radians to degrees for p, reference, command.
Original 50 Hz samples, including t=0 and terminal sample.
No smoothing, decimation, interpolation, or zero fill.
Shared output limits per comparison row; force limits fixed at +/-23 N.

figures.name: teacher_time_domain
figures.description: Lowest identifier within each source partial-quality level; all three seeds, +15 deg/s step; full response and force.

figures.name: teacher_student_time_domain
figures.description: Same L2 source object, same commands, and each paired seed; step and multisine responses and force.

figures.name: student_unseen_time_domain
figures.description: Lowest ID and OOD identifiers; all student seeds and fixed PID; two test commands with full responses and force.

figures.name: recovery_time_domain
figures.description: Same fixed OOD object as tracking; full response, a separately labeled student-only detail row, and force. All three seeds and the uncontrolled full response are retained; missing divergent tail stays missing.

figures.name: target_time_domain
figures.description: First condition identifier in each target group; middle listed seed S2, +15 deg/s step; all three target arms at the fixed endpoint.

journal_format: General research manuscript; no target journal specified.
